## Add QUSD stablecoin to official token list

QUSD is a fiat-backed USD stablecoin issued by QVTX on multiple EVM chains.

Addresses:
- Polygon: 0x8d58dEbF89740Da1416d5f1904E4286096174B5A (pQUSD, 18 decimals)
- Ethereum: 0xB57Bf3c50F20096723b46645f741F632aef220fA (QUSD, 18 decimals)
- Base: 0x02DAE538b3Cf726c04990520454Dd7AD42550b3F (baseQUSD, 6 decimals)
- Arbitrum: 0x04321b4DD2a87dc285e51FB809acF23D5cA18e17 (aQUSD, 6 decimals)

Logo: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quant-oss/qone/main/logos/QUSD.png | Website: https://qvtx.net
